# seekrit_application (Data Source)

An existing application, looked up by `slug` or `id`. Use this to attach Terraform-managed environments to an application that was created in the dashboard, without importing the application itself.

## Example Usage

```terraform
# Attach Terraform-managed environments to an application someone created in the
# dashboard, without importing the application itself.
data "seekrit_application" "web" {
  slug = "web"
}

resource "seekrit_environment" "preview" {
  application_id = data.seekrit_application.web.id
  name           = "Preview"
  slug           = "preview"
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Optional

- `id` (String) The application id (`app_…`). Set this or `slug`, not both.
- `slug` (String) The application slug, unique within the org. Set this or `id`, not both.

### Read-Only

- `created_at` (String) Creation timestamp (ISO 8601).
- `name` (String) Display name.
- `updated_at` (String) Last-update timestamp (ISO 8601).
